10906.author: sbein
10906.body:
Backport of cms-sw/cmsdist#10893 to `IB/CMSSW_15_0_X/master`.

Bump `PhysicsTools-NanoAOD` from `V01-07-00` to `V01-07-01`, providing the Run 2024 FastSim refinement payload required by the merged cms-sw/cmssw#51946 (data: cms-data/PhysicsTools-NanoAOD#21). 

Please include this in the requested CMSSW_15_0_22 production build.
10906.title: [15_0_X] Update PhysicsTools-NanoAOD data to V01-07-01

51946.author: sbein
51946.body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51943

This backport is needed for FastSim NANOv15 2024 production and re-NANO.

To adhere to the policy of keeping release continuity for changes to physics.
51946.title: Backport to CMSSW_15_0_X: FastSim jet refinement tuned on 2024
